content: अंशः [अंश्-अच्] .²1 A share, part, portion, division; member; सकृदंशो निपतति <ls>Ms. 9. 47</ls>; तुर्यांशः a fourth part; षष्ठ˚; ममैवांशो जीवलोके जीवभूतः सनातनः <ls>Bg. 15. 7</ls>; भुवमंशाविव धर्मयोर्गतौ <ls>R. 8. 16</ls>; अंशेन दर्शितानुकूलता <ls>K. 159</ls> partly. .²2 A share in property, inheritance; स्वतोंऽशतः <ls>Ms. 8. 408</ls>; अनंशौ क्लीबपतितौ <ls n="Ms.">9. 201</ls>; पत्न्यः कार्याः समांशिकाः <ls>Y. 2. 115</ls>. .²3 the numerator of a fraction; अन्योन्यहाराभिहतौ हरांशौ <ls>Līlā.</ls>; sometimes used for fraction itself. .²4 A degree of latitude (or longitude); अक्षस्यांशाः समाख्याताः षष्ट्युत्तरशतत्रयम्; स च अंशः षष्टिकलात्मकः, कला तु षष्टिविकलात्मिका. .²5 The shoulder (more correctly written as अंस, <ab>q. v.</ab>). .²6 <ab>N.</ab> of one of the Ādityas; <ls>Mb. 1. 227. 25</ls>; <ab>cf.</ab> also the beginning of <ls>T. Ār.</ls> The senses of ‘party’, ‘a share of booty’, ‘earnest money’, which are said to occur in the Veda are traceable to 1 above. .²7 The vital note in a Rāga.
